requirements.requirement: The system must render a PI credibility section within the clinical trial scorecard UI when PI data is present in the transformed payload.
The system must display the investigator name as a primary label within the PI credibility section.
The system must display the investigator institution directly beneath or adjacent to the investigator name with clear visual hierarchy.
The system must display prior clinical trial count using a human-readable formatted value (e.g., integer with label).
The system must display a publication indicator as a visual element (icon, badge, or label) when publication data is true.
The system must display the PI contribution to the overall trial score as a distinct visual element aligned with scorecard conventions.
The system must position the PI credibility section within the MessageBubble layout without breaking existing scorecard rendering.
The system must follow existing MessageBubble typography, spacing, and component styling conventions for visual consistency.
The system must render the PI credibility component as reusable and independently callable within other scorecard contexts.
The system must conditionally hide any individual PI field (name, institution, trial count, publication indicator, score contribution) if that field is null or undefined.
The system must render the remaining PI fields correctly when one or more fields are missing without breaking layout structure.
The system must not render the PI credibility section at all when the PI data object is entirely absent (exception path).
The system must render a fallback label such as "PI data unavailable" when the PI object exists but contains no usable fields (exception path).
The system must ensure that the PI credibility section does not visually dominate higher-priority scorecard elements such as overall score.
The system must render PI credibility content deterministically given identical input data (no randomness or variability in layout or values).
